events.title: The demo for Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought has been submitted to Steam for review, and I just graduated. Two things colliding in one month—I just want to talk about the act of making games itself.
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm Luomeixu. The demo for Prison Chain has been submitted to Steam for review. And I just graduated. Both of these happened in the same June, and I still haven't fully processed it. So this isn't a development update or a patch log—it's just a conversation. I want to talk about the act of making Prison Chain itself. Visual novels are a genre that requires trust. events.title: About Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought Demo Release
events.summary: Hello everyone,I'm Luomeixu, the developer of Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought. Thank you for your interest and support.The previously announced demo release has been delayed as the Steam review process is still ongoing. To ensure that the demo you receive is stable and complete, we've decided to wait for approval before making it available.The new release date will be announced as soon as the review is completed. We apologize for the inconvenience.Thank you again for your patience.— Luomeix
